description: The chart illustrates the performance of various multilingual BERT models across different language families, with the horizontal axis representing the language families, including Uralic, Semitic, Isolate, IE-other, IE-Slavic family, and IE-Romance, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "ellect" and has a linear scale ranging from 10 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family is associated with a group of four bars, representing the models mBERT, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, colored green, dark green, pink, and red, respectively. The height of each bar corresponds to its value on the "ellect" axis, with values ranging from approximately 10 to 37. For instance, the Uralic family has values around 10 for mBERT and XLM-R2, and around 11 for mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2, while the Semitic family has values around 12, 13, 37, and 35 for the respective models. The chart also includes error bars for each data point, indicating the range of uncertainty. The bars are grouped by language family, with no apparent sorting within the groups. Overall, the chart provides a visual representation of the performance of different multilingual BERT models across various language families.
